rows.label: bf03400100_0010
rows.name: This is... no place for you.

rows.label: bf03400100_0020
rows.name:
How cold. I have the "right"
to come here too.

rows.label: bf03400100_0030
rows.name:
You didn't come here to talk
about the old days, did you?

rows.label: bf03400100_0040
rows.name: We've got that brat from Minochi's place.

rows.label: bf03400100_0060
rows.name:
Come to "the place where you awakened."
You remember it, right?
